description: §18.2 — an alternation arm whose alternates bind a payload (`.Circle(r) | .Square(r) :> r`) SHALL fire E-MATCH-ALT-BINDING: an alternate carries no payload pattern.
rationale: §18.2: "The alternates of one arm SHALL NOT carry payload patterns — a binding (`.P(a: x) | .Q(a: x) :> x`), a NAMED field even when discarded (`.P(a: _) | .Q(a: _)`), or a nested / literal pattern — each SHALL produce **E-MATCH-ALT-BINDING** (§34). Only POSITIONAL `_` discards (`.P(_) | .Q(_) :> r`) are permitted."
